description.purpose: Expose one pinned Git source's independently replayed static import candidates, unverified compiler-declared source inputs, and observed runtime module loads as separate evidence categories.
description.limitations: No universal dependency completeness, compiler execution attestation, runtime mediation, independent worker signatures, safe test omission or direct semantic edge inference from compiler input membership.

schema.name: evidence_query
schema.description: One read-only query with source-bound static candidates, optional native declarations and optional runtime witnesses.

quality.name: closed_evidence_schema
quality.description: Validate all source-specific evidence variants against the strict versioned evidence-query JSON Schema.

quality.name: canonical_query_id_and_counts
quality.description: Recompute query_id, compare array counts, enforce null receipt coupling and typed evidence provenance.

quality.name: independent_source_replay
quality.description: Only the Rust source-replaying query can authenticate Git source relationships; schema validation alone cannot do so.

context.instructions: Consume each evidence family according to its own provenance. Static import candidates may be normalized to semantic-observations.v1 CANDIDATE/UNRESOLVED records, but compiler declarations and runtime witnesses must never be retyped as those records.

verifiedStatements.question: What do static candidates establish?
verifiedStatements.answer: The replayed syntax resolver nominated a source-path relationship under supported rules, not complete behavior.

verifiedStatements.question: What does a compiler input establish?
verifiedStatements.answer: An unattested native declaration names a Git-tracked source input; it does not attest compiler execution or establish a direct import.

verifiedStatements.question: What does a runtime witness establish?
verifiedStatements.answer: A self-hashed receipt records a module observed in one execution; it does not prove all other possible dependencies.

constraints.constraint: Do not promote a candidate to a compiler-confirmed or runtime-attested relation; never convert a declared compiler input into a direct import edge.
Empty arrays, absent optional receipts and no explicit gaps do not establish complete runtime or build dependency discovery or authorize test omission.
A canonical unkeyed digest and a Git blob match are not signatures proving a tool actually executed.
